goal: Make the system production-deployable with Docker and CI/CD, ensure health checks exist, and add k6 load tests to validate real-time constraints at scale.

tasks.title: Add health check endpoint
steps: Create /app/api/health/route.ts
Return 200 JSON: { status: 'ok', timestamp: ISO string }
Optionally include uptime + memory if already available

tasks.title: Dockerize application with multi-stage Dockerfile
steps: Create multi-stage Dockerfile: deps -> builder -> runner
Use node:20-alpine base image
Ensure it runs custom server.ts in production mode
Run as non-root user
Ensure container startup triggers EnvSchema validation (fail-fast)
verification: docker run starts the server successfully with correct env vars

tasks.title: Local dev environment with docker-compose
steps: Create docker-compose.yml with services: app + postgres
Optionally include redis service (for future socket scaling)
Ensure migrations apply on startup (entrypoint script or app boot hook)
Expose app and db ports for local use

tasks.title: Add CI workflow
steps: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml
Steps: install -> lint -> type-check -> test -> build
Fail workflow on any step failure
verification: CI workflow runs successfully on push/PR (simulated locally where possible)

tasks.title: Add deploy workflow skeleton
steps: Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml
Trigger on merge to main
Build docker image, push to registry, deploy step placeholder
Require GitHub Actions Secrets for credentials
verification: Workflow syntax valid and ready for target platform edits

tasks.title: Environment variable documentation
steps: Create .env.example listing all required env keys
Include placeholders and comments (no secrets)
Document storage, socket, db, auth variables

tasks.title: Add k6 load test scripts for sockets
steps: Create /load-tests/k6-script.js
Simulate high concurrency socket connections in steps (e.g., 1k -> 5k -> 10k)
Measure event RTT and compute p95 latency, assert p95 < 500ms (or record baseline if 10k is not feasible locally)
Document how to run k6 and interpret results
verification: k6 script runs and produces latency metrics

tasks.title: Deployment documentation
steps: Create DEPLOYMENT.md
Document: env vars, docker build/run, migrations, production considerations
Include socket.io-redis adapter instructions for horizontal scaling
State HTTPS/TLS termination requirement
verification: Docs are complete and consistent with repo and EnvSchema

must_provide: Exact commands to run docker build/run and docker-compose
How to run k6 and what success looks like

integration_checkpoint.name: Checkpoint H — Production Readiness Gate
must_pass: GET /api/health returns 200 in local dev and in docker
Docker image builds and container starts without errors
docker-compose boots app + postgres and applies migrations
CI workflow includes lint, type-check, test, build and fails on errors
k6 load test script exists and runs to produce latency metrics
DEPLOYMENT.md documents scaling path and required env vars

stop_condition_to_finish: All checkpoint conditions pass and the repo is deployable with documented operational procedures.
